about.title: Built lean, on purpose.
paragraphs: I'm Kaden Bokome, an independent web and systems builder based in Hampshire, UK.
Most small and mid-sized businesses get stuck between two bad options: cheap templates that look generic and convert poorly, or agencies charging £10,000+ for three months of meetings.
Zelux sits between the two. A site designed for your business and built to load fast, with the admin around it automated where that saves real time. You deal with me from the first call to launch.
about.detail: A site built around how your customers decide, loading fast on their phones, with the admin around it automated wherever it saves real hours. You deal with me from the first call to launch, and every account stays in your name.

fixedQuote.title: One fixed price. Agreed before work starts.
fixedQuote.body: Every build gets one fixed price, in writing, within 48 hours of the call, because it's scoped before it's quoted. No day rates, no surprise invoices, no VAT on top: the number you see is the number you pay.

guide.title: Clear, fixed-scope pricing.
guide.body: Bespoke websites start from £900 (no VAT charged), with optional rolling monthly care after launch. Automation builds are scoped to size after a 20-minute call.

closing.title: Tell me what's eating your week.
closing.body: Twenty minutes, free, no pitch. Tell me what's costing you time or work, and I'll tell you plainly whether I can fix it and what it would cost.

value.title: Faster to launch.
value.titleAccent: Cheaper to run. Built to earn.
value.intro: Every build is judged on three things: the time it saves you, the money it saves you, and the work it brings in.

points.t: Quote in 48 hours, live in 7 days
points.b: One 20-minute call, then a fixed written quote. Sites up to 5 pages are live within a week, guaranteed.
Bookings, reminders, invoice chasing and review requests happen on their own, so evenings stay yours.
Hosting, domain, DNS and updates are set up and looked after. You never need to log in to anything technical.
Zelux isn't VAT registered, so a £1,000 quote costs £1,000. A VAT-registered agency would bill £1,200 for the same figure.
No day rates and no surprise invoices. You know the full cost before any work starts.
Your domain, code and accounts are in your name. Care plans are rolling monthly with 30 days' notice.

points.t: Built around one job: getting you work
points.b: Every page leads to an enquiry, a booking or a sale. Nothing is there just to look busy.
New enquiries get an answer within minutes, even while you're on a job. The first business to reply is usually the one that gets hired.
Customers book and pay online at 11pm on a Sunday, instead of waiting for you to call back on Monday.

promises.title: No black boxes.
items: Nothing goes live until it's been tested with real examples from your business.
Anything that speaks for you, like a reply or a review request, waits for your approval until you say otherwise.
No made-up savings figures. If it can't be measured, it won't be promised.
No chatbot gimmicks and no tech for the sake of it.
Every account sits in your name, so you can leave whenever you like.
short: Tested on real examples from your business
Nothing speaks for you without your OK

guarantee.title: The 7-day guarantee
guarantee.terms: Sites up to 5 pages go live within 7 days, or you get £100 off the final invoice. The seven days start once the quote is accepted and your copy, photos and logins are in, and pause while a design is waiting on your feedback.
